product_family: No-code work management and project management platform with relational databases, automations, AI-assisted brainstorming (Fibery AI), and integrations. Available in Standard, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with workspace and group-level access controls.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: We have a SOC 2 Type II report performed by an independent auditing firm
certifications.source: https://fibery.com/security (verbatim quote). Certification date December 2022 and auditor Johanson Group LLP confirmed at https://fibery.com/blog/product-updates/fibery-soc-2-type-2/

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on vendor domain. Not mentioned in security page, privacy policy, or public documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Fibery offers Data Processing Addendum as well as European Union Model Contractual Clauses
certifications.source: https://fibery.com/privacy-policy (also names the Cyprus Data Protection Commissioner as Fibery's EU supervisory authority; Fibery Limited registered in Nicosia, Cyprus)

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: you will not submit to the Service ... any patient, medical or other protected health information regulated by HIPAA

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Payment processing handled through Braintree (third-party provider). Fibery does not directly manage or hold certifications for PCI compliance.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27018 certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification. Product includes Fibery AI for brainstorming and task automation, but no AI-governance certifications disclosed.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification on vendor domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: Fibery offers Fibery AI for brainstorming and task automation. Privacy policy does not explicitly disclose whether customer workspace data is used to train AI models. No opt-out mechanism mentioned for AI training. This is a gap that warrants clarification.
privacy.data_region: EU-oriented: Fibery Limited is registered in Cyprus, uses Standard Contractual Clauses for transfers, and names the Cyprus Data Protection Commissioner as its EU supervisory authority. Servers run on AWS EC2, but the specific AWS region and any multi-region residency options are not disclosed on the vendor domain (the cloud-security page states only that servers are in AWS EC2 data centers).

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS encryption with A+ rating on Qualys SSL Labs

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: All customer data encrypted at rest

security.name: Backups
security.value: AWS RDS backup solution for datastores containing customer information

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Workspace-level and group-level permissions (Pro and Enterprise plans). SAML-based Single Sign-On (Pro and Enterprise). IP whitelisting available.

security.name: Infrastructure Provider
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS) EC2 for compute. Twilio (SendGrid) for email delivery.

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Customer data removed within 6 months after subscription termination. Account owner information retained typically up to 6 years for legitimate business purposes.

security.name: Geographic Restrictions
security.value: As of September 9, 2024, access blocked from: Russia, Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Crimea, Sudan, and Syria.

products.name: Fibery Standard
products.data_scope: All workspace data. No health/medical data (HIPAA-regulated data prohibited).
products.notes: Entry-level tier. Includes relational databases, views (table, board, gallery, list, timeline, Gantt, calendar, report, map, feed, form, dashboard), automations, formulas, integrations, and Fibery AI.

products.name: Fibery Pro
products.data_scope: All workspace data with enhanced access controls. SAML SSO, IP whitelisting available. No health/medical data (HIPAA-regulated data prohibited).
products.notes: Mid-market tier. Adds group-level permissions, SAML SSO, and IP whitelisting over Standard.

products.name: Fibery Enterprise
products.data_scope: All workspace data with full access control granularity. No health/medical data (HIPAA-regulated data prohibited).
products.notes: Enterprise tier. Adds dedicated support and advanced administrative controls. Specific data-residency region options are not documented on the vendor domain.

products.name: Fibery AI
products.data_scope: Workspace data (scope of training not disclosed)
products.notes: AI-assisted brainstorming and task automation feature. Privacy policy does not explicitly disclose whether workspace data is used to train Fibery AI models. No public opt-out documented.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based SaaS with three tiers (Standard, Pro, Enterprise). Enterprise plans available with custom pricing and data residency options.
compare.data_residency: EU-oriented (Cyprus-registered entity, EU supervisory authority, SCCs for transfers). Specific AWS region not disclosed on the vendor domain.

flags: SOC 2 Type II certification is from December 2022, over 3 years old. Type II audits are typically renewed every 1-2 years. Vendor should publish current/renewed cert.
No ISO 27001 certification despite offering enterprise tiers. This is unusual for a growth-stage B2B SaaS platform targeting enterprises.

Fibery AI feature exists but privacy policy contains no disclosure of whether customer workspace data is used for AI model training. No opt-out mechanism documented. Requires clarification from vendor.
Not HIPAA-compliant and explicitly prohibits health/medical data. Limits use case in regulated healthcare sector.
Trust center is not a dedicated subdomain (e.g., trust.fibery.com) but a page within the main site (/security). This is acceptable but less standard than dedicated trust centers.
